::: {.callout-note icon="false"}
## 📘 About This Series

ARCS is a four-session workshop series introducing reproducible research computing with R. No prior programming experience is required. Each session builds on the last — participants leave with a working, version-controlled, reproducible project built from scratch.

For background on the series, its goals, and how to reuse these materials, see the [About page](/).
:::
